protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

documentId.title:
客户端自选 document_id；documents:count / documents:bulkUpdate /
documents:bulkDelete 为自定义方法段（REST 自定义动词），不再占用
document_id 命名空间，可自由取任意合法值。

version.title: 用户集合强制 OCC：必须与当前行 _version 相等；未设置 = version_required。

用户集合为当前 _version；系统集合恒为 0。

conflictColumns.title: upsert 的冲突列（须匹配集合唯一索引），随 op 持久化供 Commit 回放。

v1Comparison.description: Comparison is a leaf predicate: attribute plus one or more values.

v1Filter.description:
Filter is a boolean expression tree. Comparison ops use Appwrite-equivalent
semantics; and/or are recursive. The Appwrite string codec remains implicit AND.

v1FilterList.description: FilterList is a boolean combination of Filter nodes (and / or).

v1Order.description: Order is a single sort key. desc=false is ascending.

v1Query.description:
Query is the typed document list/count model (filter tree + orders + page).
page_token is the authoritative pager (K-20); page_size is the page bound.
